# C550 FA2: all 562 shapes, two counterbalanced rounds

The before snapshot already contains the preceding retained optimizations; it differs from after only in the final short-KV packed dispatch and is not the original PR head.

Fresh before/after public-operator GPU Event measurements; no CUDA Graph. Each round uses six alternating INT8/BF16 batches, 20 ms target, at least two calls, four warmup calls, median. Round two reverses both per-case measurement order and worker creation order. Shown latencies are the arithmetic mean of the two per-round medians. The common BF16 reference is the mean of all four BF16 medians for that index; both independently measured BF16 columns are retained. Raw timing samples and output checks are included in measurements-forward.jsonl and measurements-reverse.jsonl.

Real captured shape, per-request sequence metadata, and invocation counts are replayed with seeded synthetic tensors, scales, and page mappings. Every before/after output in both rounds passes abs(error) <= 0.03 + 0.03*abs(BF16 reference). LSE is checked by the separate strict tests.

Index is the original zero-based index (0–561). Calls are captured counts, not benchmark iterations. Weighted speedup = sum(count * (common BF16 / INT8)) / sum(count); this is not end-to-end throughput.
